title: spoke_integrity_score.py: hooks dimension scoring bug fixed — 15/20 cap → 20/20
signal: score_hooks() declared max=20 but awarded 3pts per hook (5x3=15 max achievable). All spokes with all 5 hooks correctly configured were scoring 15/20 instead of 20/20. Fixed: changed to 4pts per hook (5x4=20). Framework spoke integrity score: 89→94/100. Committed in 0eee082.
rationale: Affected every spoke using spoke_integrity_score.py. Spokes with correct hooks appeared to have a 5pt gap they could never close. Fix deployed — all spoke scores should be re-run to reflect corrected formula.
